title: Browse, where a newcomer finds the neighbourhood

criteria.text: Browse is its own surface at `/explore`, reached from its own entry; not merged with Home
criteria.note: Explore is its own surface at `/explore`; `/` is the signed-out front door and the proxy sends a signed-in member to Explore (`src/app/page.tsx` header) [V]. There has been no bottom tab bar since #1095 (2026-10-31); the entry is the header's SocialUs link plus the ➕ and the You avatar [A, from #1095]. Checked no: nothing asserts Home is not merged in (#589) [V grep]. Reviewed no: #138 and #308 carry no `Reviewed by:` [A]. Shipped yes on the PRs read before [A]. Smoked: smoke-live run 45885931303 (2026-11-26, main 71107bcd, after #1454, #1459, #1461, #1484) opened explore and explore-map as signed-out, stranger, member and operator, HTTP 200 and passed; the run is red on page and page-business (member, operator) and on the ownerBusiness and operator sign-ins, not on explore [V gh run log]; it loads the route, it does not tap.

criteria.text: Pages and posts together, complete: nothing withheld that the reader may see
criteria.note: Built half [V]: the default view mixes Pages, posts and followed updates (#881). Missing: completeness. `BROWSE_LIMIT = 100` still caps every read with no paging (`src/app/explore/load.ts:71`, used at 159, 195, 197, 330), Pages and posts sharing the slots [V]. Open #828 (the cap); check in #589.

criteria.text: Order is locality and recency (may carry community response); never payment, size, follower count or what keeps someone scrolling
criteria.note: `browse_feed` orders by recency inside the nearest reach ring (#932, #1086); `mixRuns` (#902) breaks runs of one category; search orders by text rank (#924) [A, unchanged since 11-20: no merge since touched the order, `git log` of src/app/explore, src/lib/browse, src/components/browse shows only #1459, #1461, #1484]. No guard scans for payment, size, follower or engagement inputs (#590). The 2026-10-31 ruling lets Find sort by interests and interaction; that does not lift the payment clause. Reviewed no (#161, #558, #815, #902, #1086) [A]. criteria.text: Curated lenses (on today, local food, household, art, free things, newly opened Pages), each a way to change what is discoverable
criteria.note: Built half: the 'What's happening' rows (F091) and the filter sheet's Category and My interests groups (#881, #911) [A]. criteria.text: A list at every width, with no List | Map switch and no Map pill; a map appears only as part of an answer to a member's question

[V PR body, BrowseSurface.layout.test.tsx]. The map as part of an F119 answer is not built and not needed for this criterion's 'only'. Checked yes: `[guards F059.5]` on `BrowseSurface.layout.test.tsx:140` asserts a list and no map, link, button or tablist at 390 to 1440px, member and visitor, the ➕ menu, and an old `?view=map` link; #1459 says it failed 13 ways against main before [V]. The eval `F059-explore-list-and-map-by-width.spec.ts` carries a partial marker (signed out only). Reviewed yes (#1459 `Reviewed by:` a second session). Shipped yes: deploy-health green on 722b7a26 [V]. criteria.text: Results scope to the vantage's market: the member's home market by default, a typed place for the session
criteria.note: Built half [V `src/lib/browse/scope.ts`]: a member's own market comes from a tapped switcher or link, their setting, then their zip's market. Missing: a typed place held for the session (F105) and the market model of F104 (a waiting market's Pages absent). Open #696 and #698, both `deferred`.
